summary: Focused re-test of 3 fixes from iteration_14 + early-access regression. All 4 checks PASS.

FIX_1_partnership_capture.evidence: E2E via Playwright: clicked closing-partner -> landing-modal-partnership opened -> filled name/email/org/message -> landing-modal-success rendered. Mongo doc for qa-partner@example.com contains source='partnership' and application_data={name:'QA Partner', organization:'Acme Health', message:'Verifying capture'}.

FIX_2_meta_tags.evidence: curl of index.html confirms og:type=website, og:url, og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image, and <link rel='canonical' href='https://letitgo.ai/'>.

FIX_3_meta_description.evidence: <meta name='description'> = 'Let It Go AI — the first Emotional Intelligence Ecosystem. Sense the moment, release the weight, grow the pattern, transform the day.' — no reference to 'A product of emergent.sh'.

REGRESSION_early_access.evidence: POST /api/waitlist with {email, audience:'individual', source:'early_access'} returns 200 and DB doc has application_data=null (no leak from partnership-only field).

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up qa-partner@example.com and qa-earlyaccess@example.com waitlist docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration_14 fixes verified. Partnership modal properly attaches application_data, meta tags/canonical present, description no longer references emergent.sh, and early_access flow does not attach application_data.
